# Prevention owner-runtime terminal-closure research v10

The canonical envelope hash is `16a9e5f76cda8979dc36f3f17027ab2b0836cfc1c0b50bd423823150f99421cd`; its embedded charter and requirements hashes match. The frozen owner policy remains exactly 10 `AVAILABLE`, 6 `CUSTODIAN_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED`, and 9 `UNAVAILABLE`. Availability and executable admission are separate: an AVAILABLE row is executable only after its approved proposal is content-addressed and materialized, its complete owner-derived budget and providers resolve, and its lifecycle, semantic-terminal, parent, and parameter/root gates pass. Current `PreventionController` instead treats AVAILABLE plus an old owner-contract hash as executable.

## Public material-gap classification

- `MG-O1` is a `PLANNER_OWNED_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP`: current budgets are supplied through `PreventionController.unit_budgets`; the target derives the complete budget from the selected approved contract after command/mode materialization and rejects missing, incomplete, understated, or insufficient budgets before effects.
- `MG-O2` is a `PLANNER_OWNED_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP`: `OwnerRuntime.run()` maps every recovered `STARTED` effect to `INDETERMINATE`; the target invokes the selected owner's typed reconciler and returns `ALREADY_APPLIED`, `NOT_APPLIED`, or `INDETERMINATE` from prepared identities and authoritative observables.
- `MG-O3` is a `PLANNER_OWNED_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP`: current exit zero directly creates a terminal JSON file, stdout is not semantically verified, and the event schema has no `owner_terminal`; the target re-observes command-specific evidence and appends exactly one terminal event and matching artifact.
- `MG-O4` is a `PLANNER_OWNED_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP`: the manifest records `mawf-playbook-blocker-reentry` as child-only, but controller/selector/adapter dispatch does not enforce parent state; the target requires an active allowed parent and atomically consumed `child_delegation_recorded` event.
- `MG-O5` is a `PLANNER_OWNED_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP`: adapters use hard-coded flag/path lists instead of the approved materialized schemas, do not resolve trusted roots or secret/resource providers, and do not prove symlink containment before argv construction.

## Exact current lifecycle and event boundary

Current checkpoint statuses are `PREPARED`, `STARTED`, `EXECUTED`, and `TERMINAL`. Preparation emits `transition_prepared` with transition `EFFECT_PREPARED`, then `effect_prepared`; execution emits `effect_committed`; recovery can emit `effect_reconciled`. `PREVENTION_EVENT_FIELDS` currently defines `action_intent_recorded`, `action_eligibility_recorded`, `host_capability_recorded`, `host_action_observed`, `dispatch_selected`, `dispatch_rejected`, `predecessor_prohibited`, `budget_admitted`, `budget_rejected`, `transition_prepared`, `transition_committed`, `effect_prepared`, `effect_committed`, `effect_reconciled`, `registered_reuse_recorded`, `prevented_failure_recorded`, and `timing_interval_recorded`. It defines no `owner_terminal`, `child_delegation_recorded`, or approval/provider receipt event.

## Complete parent comparison

All 25 manifest rows were compared. The sole child-only row is `mawf-playbook-blocker-reentry`, `standalone=false`, with parents `mawf-playbook-full-test` and `mawf-playbook-speed-test`. The other 24 rows are `standalone=true` with no parent: `local-workflow-orch-image`, `greenfield-full-drive`, `remote-mcp-user-onboarding`, `taggable-source-reload`, `mawf-playbook-full-test`, `mawf-playbook-speed-test`, `github-app-repos-refresh`, `claude-auth-token-refresh`, `taggable-api-deploy`, `taggable-admin-spa-deploy`, `taggable-media-worker-deploy`, `airgapped-local-bulgarian-stt`, `airgapped-redaction-stack`, `callcenter-harness-provision-verify`, `airgapped-llm-judge`, `secure-landing-seed`, `callcenter-harness-engine-invariants`, `discovery-promotion-lifecycle`, `commit-push-main`, `discovery-bootstrap`, `discovery-candidate-reconciliation`, `convergence-checkpoint-run`, `scoped-context-edit`, and `convergence-state-review-cycle`. Both allowed parents are presently `CUSTODIAN_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED`; this preserves 10/6/9 and means the AVAILABLE child must remain non-admissible until an allowed parent has an executable contract and active matching journal effect.

## Ten owner surfaces

`local-workflow-orch-image` currently has commands build, run, health, copy-code-project, logs, stop, seed-codex-auth, seed-git-auth, probe-codex, and require-real-memory-knowledge. Its approved budget is 28,800,000 ms; the target adds command-specific labels/receipts/reconciliation, semantic verifiers, fixed roots, and repository-key bindings.

`greenfield-full-drive` currently exposes raw repo/spec plus drive/checkpoint flags and prints sequence completion after detached launch. Approved modes are start-from-spec, create-program, and resume-program. Each atomic task is capped at 3,600,000 ms including retry; every launchable frontier member is reserved; caps are 20 features, 5 validation rounds, 4 fatal defects per round, and 20 fix chains. Durable task/run/programDriveId and driveStatus state replace host checkpoint authority; semantic completion requires completed program state, validated result, settled coverage, and matching authenticated remote head.

`mawf-playbook-blocker-reentry` currently supports start-over, restart-workflow, and resume. `cmd_reenter` omits targetRunId and returns zero after printing blocked/error envelopes. Approved budget is 28,800,000 ms; target fields are parent-derived and delegation-bound, with exact target-run reconciliation and semantic state verification.

`claude-auth-token-refresh` currently supports status, mint, seed-local, seed-host, push-kv, reseed-azure, verify, and all with raw file/container/vault inputs. Approved budget is 28,800,000 ms. Target inputs are typed secret/resource handles; only non-secret fingerprints/versions persist; exact Claude-auth probes are mandatory.

`discovery-promotion-lifecycle` currently supports status, drive, correct, and correct-registered and can execute a Markdown-derived verification command. Approved simple-command budget is 28,800,000 ms and drive is 57,600,000 ms across at most nine progressively reserved transitions. Verification becomes a typed child owner with its own budget, reconciler, and semantic receipt.

`commit-push-main` currently selects publish/resume/integration behavior through flags and accepts raw repo/remote inputs. Approved modes and budgets are dry-run 28,800,000; publish 39,600,000; resume-push 36,000,000; integrate-remote-and-resume 46,800,000; isolated-integrate-and-resume 46,800,000; isolated-reconcile-and-resume 50,400,000 ms. Mutations require an exact single-use authorization receipt and deterministic Prevention-Effect-ID commit trailer; approval of the contract authorizes no publication.

`discovery-bootstrap` currently supports start and already creates deterministic artifacts and run_started. Approved budget is 28,800,000 ms; target root/spec authority is fixed, exact artifact prefixes reconcile, and terminal success re-observes the complete matrix.

`discovery-candidate-reconciliation` currently supports audit, validate, execute, execute-rolling, and drive with caller root/index/policy/attempt inputs. Target fixes these authorities, caps rolling at six, requires a disposition receipt, derives budgets from each frozen manifest, and uses deterministic attempts/children. Budgets are 28,800,000 ms for audit/validate; `(9 + N + 15P)*3,600,000` for execute; `(7 + SUM(4 + N_i + 15P_i))*3,600,000` for rolling; and `(15 + SUM(4 + N_i + 15P_i))*3,600,000` for drive.

`convergence-checkpoint-run` currently accepts raw command_json argv plus caller repo/helper/stage/timeout and trusts exit zero plus a pass string. Target reserves 28,800,000 ms plus the exact child budget, fixes authority fields, uses a guarded typed child intent, reconciles baseline and child independently, and composes the child semantic terminal artifact.

`convergence-state-review-cycle` currently accepts request v1, optional apply/dry-run, and returns COMPLETE from helper exit codes. Target dry-run budget is 28,800,000 ms and apply is `(M+9)*3,600,000`; request v2 adds request/operation ids, initial-state hash, expected final status, external approval receipts, atomic operation receipts, and distinct cycle/convergence status.

## Trusted binding/provider locators

No external value is invented. Static roots are the literal approved proposal `trusted_roots`, hashed into each materialized contract. Local repository roots already have a locator through `work_memory._repo_roots`, using an explicit snapshot/file and canonical memory-knowledge default. Remote repository keys already have a creation path through `build_git_manager_from_settings`, which reads configured `repo_mapping_path` and constructs `GitRemoteManager(repo_mapping=...)`. Dynamic secret, Docker, vault, deployment, operator-environment, publication/disposition/external-approval, and delegation providers have approved contracts but no prevention resolver today. Planning is unblocked: create controller-owned typed resolver interfaces keyed only by the approved provider/registry names; bind exact non-secret lookup identities/versions into effect preparation; persist single-use receipts as closed prevention events consumed atomically with preparation; reject unresolved keys before reservation. Production registrations remain operator/authority configuration, not caller arguments; their absence makes only the applicable invocation non-admissible and does not change 10/6/9.

All five current requirements are answered from accessible source. All five future requirements are grounded by approved proposals and authority decisions; live proof is correctly NOT_YET_APPLICABLE. Planning must implement MG-O1..MG-O5 as one coordinated materialization/runtime change without altering owner availability or authorizing deployment, commit, push, credential access, or an external message.
